repository.description: CarPaly — Android CarPlay receiver project with Geely Xingyue L (KX11) compatibility development.

candidate.summaryZh: v1.1.56/code 44 是本地候选，包含设置页整合及统一结构化诊断日志增强；本轮尚未生成 APK。音乐自动暂停仍为历史问题，本轮没有修改音频状态机。实车功能均未测试；签名身份需先解决顶层 AGENTS 要求与版本台账签名代际之间的冲突。
candidate.summaryEn: v1.1.56/code 44 is a local candidate with the settings-page consolidation and unified structured diagnostic logging; no APK has been built for this source. The media auto-pause remains a historical issue and the audio state machine was not changed. Vehicle functions are not tested. The signing identity must be reconciled between the supplied top-level AGENTS requirement and the version-ledger signing epoch.
releaseNotesZh: v1.1.56/code 44 是本地候选，不代表 GitHub Release；本轮修改源码尚未构建 APK。
本轮将应用更新完整控件整合到关于页面，保留既有更新业务逻辑、持久化和单一诊断导出入口。
增加应用私有、脱敏、限量滚动的结构化运行日志，并对重复旧诊断行限流；不记录协议载荷或原始音频。
保留 V1.1.55 的 OPUS 输出能力探测修复。音乐自动暂停仍是历史反馈；V1.1.54 日志未复现，根因未知，本轮未修改音频状态机。
实车 CarPlay、音乐、导航语音、顶部状态栏、HUD、仪表、方向盘及车辆数据均未针对本轮源码实测。签名身份规则冲突解决前不构建 Release APK；OTA 未启用。
releaseNotesEn: v1.1.56/code 44 is a local candidate, not a GitHub Release; the modified source has not been built into an APK.
The full app-update controls now live in About, reusing the existing update logic, persistence, and single diagnostic-export flow.
Adds a private, redacted, size-bounded structured runtime log with duplicate-line rate limiting; it does not record protocol payloads or raw audio.

Retains the V1.1.55 OPUS output capability detection fix. Media auto-pause remains a historical report; V1.1.54 logs did not reproduce it, its cause is unknown, and this round did not change the audio state machine.

Real-vehicle CarPlay, media, navigation audio, OEM status-bar, HUD, cluster, steering-wheel, and vehicle-data behavior has not been tested against this source. No Release APK will be built until the signer-policy conflict is resolved; OTA remains disabled.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈连接正常；测试 APK 版本、车型配置及有线/无线模式未记录，维护者未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported a normal connection; APK version, vehicle trim, and wired/wireless mode were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 历史用户反馈称音乐播放约一秒后自动暂停，唤醒 Siri 时可播放；V1.1.54 日志未复现该现象，根因未知，本轮未实车复测。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: Historical user feedback reported that music paused after about one second but played while Siri was active. The V1.1.54 logs did not reproduce this; the cause is unknown and no vehicle retest occurred in this round.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈导航提示音无声；根因及修复状态尚未由本轮新实车复测确认。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported silent navigation prompts; the root cause and any fix have not been confirmed by a new vehicle retest.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈可听见 Siri 且 Siri 能听见用户；未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported hearing Siri and being heard by Siri; not independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈按键有响应；具体按键与映射未记录，未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported responsive keys; individual keys and mappings were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈仍遮挡 CarPlay 画面。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported that the OEM status bar still overlaps the CarPlay view.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 没有可核实的实车接口调用或验收证据。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: No verifiable in-vehicle interface call or acceptance evidence is available.
